name: build-triage/ambiguous-log-flat-01
note: The log says almost nothing: a large option set with a near-flat distribution, or a decisive 'unknown'.

state.log_excerpt:
[12:04:18] Running step: test
[12:04:19] > make test
[12:07:52] Error: Process completed with exit code 1.

category.instructions: Identify the root cause of the build failure.

criteria.type_error: Type mismatch or unresolved symbol at compile time
criteria.test_assertion: Unit, integration, or end-to-end assertion failure
criteria.test_timeout: A test exceeded its time limit
criteria.infrastructure: Out of memory, disk exhaustion, or container runtime error
criteria.network: DNS, TLS, or connection failure to an external service
criteria.permissions: Credential, token, or filesystem permission failure
criteria.configuration: Missing or malformed environment or config value
criteria.flaky: Non-deterministic failure with no code cause
criteria.unknown: The log does not contain enough to categorize the failure
